series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: Merge OpenClose MA crossover and RSI-midpoint (buy RSI<50 / sell RSI>50) under STRATEGY_MODE: MODE_ONE requires both strategies to agree on direction (voting policy); MODE_TWO/THREE assign long vs short responsibility to one strategy each. Holding period maturity closes positions. Genetic optimizer + 1/2 forward test ranks modes; voting policy looked most stable OOS.
data_needed: EMA on open/close, RSI on close; D1 bars; holding-period timer; Strategy Tester genetic optimizer with forward split.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; PERIOD_D1; holding period 5 daily bars; backtest ~2022–2025 with random delay
why_new_for_mis: Treats multi-strategy agreement / role-split as an explicit regime sensor of signal consensus rather than a single-indicator state—MIS can score when oscillators and MA structure cohere.
quote: Under this policy, a trade is only placed if both the moving average and RSI strategies agree on the same direction.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: Three strategies (MA crossover, RSI midpoint, WPR>50/<50) each cast ±weight_i into a net vote; long if vote>0, short if vote<0. Weights in [0,1] are free inputs to the genetic optimizer (not forced to sum to 1). Optimizer can drive a weak strategy’s weight toward 0, effectively pruning the ensemble; usefulness of each strategy is configuration-dependent across back vs forward.
data_needed: MA, RSI, WPR buffers on chosen TF; three continuous vote weights; holding period; cloud/genetic optimization with forward half.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; STRATEGY_TIME_FRAME default PERIOD_D1; tests ~Feb 2023–May 2025; MQL5 Cloud Network
why_new_for_mis: Turns genetic weight search into a sensing readout of which sub-strategies currently contribute—MIS can track live contribution weights as a meta-sensor of strategy relevance, not just price regime.
quote: If the optimizer determines that one of our strategies isn’t positively contributing to overall performance, it will set the weight of that strategy’s vote close to zero.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: Classical dual-period MA crossover on higher TF (D1) sets directional bias; entries only when lower TF (M15) crossover aligns (trend mode) or opposes then fades (mean-reverting mode). Exits can be keyed to HTF or LTF crossover flip via CLOSING_TIME_FRAME enum. Period gaps enforce non-zero fast/slow separation.
data_needed: Four iMA handles (fast/slow on TF_1 and TF_2); strategy_mode and closing_tf enums; genetic search over periods/gaps/modes.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; HTF PERIOD_D1, LTF PERIOD_M15, risk TF PERIOD_H4; backtest 2020–~2025 with 1/2 forward
why_new_for_mis: Formalizes ‘trade with higher TF’ as a dual-TF regime+confirmation sensor with explicit trend vs fade entry ideologies—useful MIS multi-scale regime stack.
quote: The higher timeframe provides a directional bias for the day, while the lower timeframe is where we look for entry signals that align with that bias.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: Stop-loss padding = mean(high−low) over HISTORICAL_BARS on an intermediate risk timeframe (default H4 between D1 and M15). Padding trails winning positions; genetic optimizer may retune TF_3 and bar count.
data_needed: High/low rate vectors on TF_3; HISTORICAL_BARS; bid/ask for trailing SL modify.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; risk TF H4 (tunable); 10 bars default then optimized; used with D1/M15 strategy
why_new_for_mis: Uses mid-scale bar-range mean as a live volatility/risk sensor decoupled from signal TFs—MIS can sense local range expansion for stops without conflating it with entry regime.
quote: This makes it a useful candidate for measuring market risk and setting stop losses that are neither too tight nor too far from the entry.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: Z-score OHLC + MA(close/high/low) inputs (8 incl. intercept); SVD (OpenBLAS SingularValueDecompositionDC) solves multi-output OLS for four simultaneous targets: future MA close, MA high, MA low, and close. Entries require forecasted MA/price above (buy) or below (sell) spot plus forecasted MA-low/high clearing ATR stops; exits if forecasts turn against.
data_needed: 90 bars D1 OHLC and three MAs; ATR; horizon=1; matrix X,y and coefficient matrix b.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; PERIOD_D1; MA period 2; ATR SL on D1; ~2022–2025 backtest
why_new_for_mis: Multi-target linear factorization as a joint fair-value / channel-path sensor—MIS can fuse expected MA envelope and price path rather than a single scalar forecast.
quote: we aim to predict four different targets: The future moving average of the close … high … low … and the future value of price

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: SVD linear classifier outputs two soft binary scores: (1) whether MA will rise/fall, (2) whether price will sit above/below MA. Buy only if both predictions >0.5; sell if both <0.5—requiring anticipated MA direction and price acceleration beyond the MA. Close if held position’s MA-direction prediction flips.
data_needed: Z-scored OHLC+MA inputs (6); binary labels from lagged vs current close and close-vs-MA; 200 bars; ATR stops.
why_new_for_mis: Splits ‘trend of smoother’ from ‘price vs smoother gap’ into two binary change sensors that must agree—MIS can gate on structural acceleration, not direction alone.
quote: Both predictions should be greater than 0.5 for us to buy. Additionally, both predictions should be less than 0.5 for us to sell.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: After OBSERVATIONS=90 daily scenes of strategy snapshots (OHLC, balance, equity, MA high/low, one-hot position state), fit linear map X→next-snapshot via PInv. Predict next balance/MA; grant trade permission only if predicted balance rises or predicted MA momentum confirms the pending buy/sell; otherwise pause. Learns strategy↔market relation, not raw price alone.
data_needed: 12-feature snapshot matrix growing over scenes; account balance/equity; MA channel + ATR baseline strategy; boolean predict/permission flags.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; PERIOD_D1; MA period 10 high/low channel; 5-year backtest ~2020–2025
why_new_for_mis: Closed-loop system identification on strategy state is a sensing layer over win/loss structure—MIS can gate actions when predicted account trajectory turns adverse.
quote: If the next trade was predicted to be unprofitable, the system simply paused trading until better market conditions were expected.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: Hold feedback-controller architecture fixed; A/B transform snapshot matrix X before PInv: (a) raw, (b) column z-score, (c) X/X.Norm(MATRIX_NORM_P1) L1 unit scaling, (d) L1 then z-score hybrid. Unit scaling improved profit ~12%, Sharpe ~30%, fewer trades, less gross loss; z-score and hybrid hurt—preprocessing treated as high-leverage sensing knob.
data_needed: Same 12-feature snapshots and PInv controller as Part 13; matrix L1 norm; identical 2020–2025 EURUSD D1 window.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; PERIOD_D1; same feedback controller test dates across transforms
why_new_for_mis: Shows input geometry (L1 unit scale vs z-score) materializes different learnable structure for the same controller—MIS should treat feature transforms as tunable sensing parameters, not fixed plumbing.
quote: After scaling with the L1 norm, we noticed that our application’s profitability levels improved by 12 percent over the baseline … Sharpe ratio improved by 30 percent

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: On EURUSD D1, line-search training fraction of recent history (10%…100% of train half) to minimize OOS RMSE of close forecasts; find ~60% of first half is enough—trim older incoherent history before fitting Ridge/ONNX. Frames ‘how much past still matches present’ as a measurable memory length.
data_needed: MT5 copy_rates D1 OHLC; train/test split; TimeSeriesSplit; progressive partition_index by fraction.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; TIMEFRAME_D1; HORIZON=10; drop last ~2y before backtest window; models OLS/Ridge/RF/GBR/KNN/SVR/MLP
why_new_for_mis: Operationalizes market-memory length as a sensing hyperparameter—MIS can estimate coherent history depth per instrument/TF instead of using all available bars.
quote: only about 60% of the first half is required to accurately predict the remaining half.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: Replace fixed MA rules with ONNX supervised model (Ridge/tuned MLP on OHLC→future close) for entries (price vs MA + model direction); after 90 scenes, SVD linear system ID on snapshots (OHLC, MA, equity, balance) forecasts next balance and only allows check_signal when forecasted balance > current—supervised market model supervised by closed-loop account sensor.
data_needed: ONNX model 1×4→1×1; FEATURES=7 snapshots; OBSERVATIONS=90; ATR padding; D1 EURUSD.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; PERIOD_D1; MA period 42; ~2y backtest after training cutoff
why_new_for_mis: Stacks a market-price neural/linear sensor with an account-trajectory system-ID gate—MIS can separate ‘market prediction’ from ‘is this strategy healthy now’ sensing.
quote: Can we learn to optimally control a trading strategy that is itself defined by a statistical model of the market?

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: MA high/low channel breakout (human rule) and Ridge ONNX trained on the same OHLC+MA features must agree: e.g. price above channel AND both forecasted close−MA_H and close−MA_L deviations positive for buys (later: multi-horizon MA H/L at +1 and +HORIZON must rise together with open-MA vs close-MA sentiment). Unprofitable alone; stacked agreement becomes profitable without retuning MA period.
data_needed: EMA high/low channel; OHLC+MA CSV; Ridge→ONNX (8→2 or 8→4); ATR padding; hourly decision cadence on D1 indicators.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; PERIOD_D1; MA period 20 (untuned); ~2022–2025; HORIZON=20 for multi-step targets
why_new_for_mis: Centralizes sensing on shared indicators so rule and model correct each other—MIS ensemble gate on identical feature bus without separate tuning stacks.
quote: Requiring the strategy to open positions only when both the traditional and statistical components agreed produced a profitable outcome from two independently unprofitable systems.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: Replace raw return target with ΔSMA(close) over HORIZON=5 (~81% direction harmony with true returns). Feed SMA OHLC + 5 lags (24 cols) to FastICA; accuracy vs binary SMA-change peaks around 12–18 components (decorrelated manifold). KNR approximates ICA embedding from SMA inputs; second KNR maps embedding→smoothed return; ONNX cascade drives D1 long/short.
data_needed: SMA O/H/L/C + lags 1–5; FastICA n_components; KNeighborsRegressor pair; ONNX 24→12 and 12→1; ATR stops.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; PERIOD_D1; MA period/type inputs (e.g. 5 SMA); OOS ~2023–2026; ~7y history in notebook
why_new_for_mis: Time-lagged ICA on already-smoothed indicators is a blind source-separation noise sensor—MIS can project MA lag stacks into independent components before forecasting.
quote: When given time-lagged data, ICA could possibly find independent sources of temporal structure in the data that explain the correlation across time.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
mechanism: KMeans (k=5) on 12-D ICA manifold; measure per-cluster classification error of LSVC on held-out train half. Residual noise mostly uniform across clusters; one low-error cluster was too rare to exploit—clusters proposed as candidate regimes for sizing or filtering if populated.
data_needed: ICA train_manifold; KMeans labels; model predictions vs New Bin Target; cluster error rates and label histogram.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD D1 ICA features from SMA lags; analysis on training manifold before ONNX export
why_new_for_mis: Unsupervised partitions of ICA space as residual-noise / performance regimes—MIS can sense ‘which manifold neighborhood’ the market occupies for confidence gating.
quote: The identification of a group with high accuracy may indicate repeating market conditions under which we excel.
